title: Import resources and reconcile drift
intro:
Your team manages an app VPC and subnet with Terraform. Someone created a legacy VPC and security group by hand, and someone else changed tags in the console.

The configuration is in `/home/coder/lab` and is already initialized and applied. Open a terminal in the editor via **☰ → Terminal → New Terminal**. The `aws` CLI talks to the emulated AWS account, region `us-east-1`.

tasks.text: Bring the VPC tagged `Name = legacy-vpc` under Terraform management as `aws_vpc.legacy`. Use an `import` block. Afterwards `terraform plan` must show no changes for it.
Bring the security group named `legacy-web` under management as `aws_security_group.legacy_web`, without changing it. Its rules must stay as they are.
Someone changed the `Environment` tag of the app VPC to `prod` in the console. That change was not approved: the VPC must be back to `Environment = dev`.
Someone added the tag `Owner = platform` to the app subnet. The team wants to keep it. Make the configuration match, and make sure the tag still exists in AWS.
Finish with a clean workspace: `terraform plan` reports no changes.
